en.endings.saved_with_coach.title: Hollow Creek is saved
en.endings.saved_with_coach.body: The board votes to keep the club. Maple Ridge High calls with a job offer, and your coach comes with you.
en.endings.saved_with_kid.title: Hollow Creek is saved
en.endings.saved_with_kid.body: The board votes to keep the club. Maple Ridge High offers you the program, and Mason enrolls there too.
en.endings.saved_alone.title: Hollow Creek is saved
en.endings.saved_alone.body: The board votes to keep the club. You head to Maple Ridge High on your own.
en.endings.club_sold.title: The club is sold
en.endings.club_sold.body: The board votes to sell. The FOR SALE sign stays up, and Hollow Creek closes at the end of the month.
en.endings.sold_to_developer.title: Sold to the developer
en.endings.sold_to_developer.body: You take the money. The courts will be townhouses by spring.
en.endings.bankrupt.title: Out of money
en.endings.bankrupt.body: The club cannot make payroll. The bank takes over and the act ends.
en.events.hc_dale_phone.title: Coach Dale is on his phone during the junior lesson
en.events.hc_dale_phone.body: Tyler is hitting balls into the fence and Mason is sitting on the court. Dale has not looked up in ten minutes.
en.events.hc_dale_phone.options.A: Walk down to Court 1 and talk to him
en.events.hc_parent_complaint.title: Ms. Carter wants a word about the lessons
en.events.hc_parent_complaint.body: "My son paid for lessons, not babysitting." She is standing at the gate of Court 1.
en.events.hc_board_memo.title: The board wants you to deal with Coach Dale
en.events.hc_board_memo.body: Program quality has collapsed and members are leaving. The board expects action today.
en.events.hc_board_memo.options.A: Fire him in front of the class
en.events.hc_board_memo.options.B: Let him go privately on the deck
en.events.hc_dale_relapse.title: Dale is back on his phone
en.events.hc_dale_relapse.body: One more chance lasted a day. The juniors are hitting balls at each other.
en.events.hc_hire_coach.title: Hire a new head coach
en.events.hc_hire_coach.body: Three people answered the ad. Whoever you pick could follow you after Hollow Creek.
en.events.hc_fix_court1.title: Court 1 is falling apart
en.events.hc_fix_court1.body: The cracks have weeds in them and the net sags in the middle. A local crew can patch it this week.
en.events.hc_fix_court1.options.A: Patch the cracks and replace the net · −$350
en.events.hc_trial_day.title: Host a free trial day?
en.events.hc_trial_day.body: Open the gates for an afternoon and see who shows up. Being on Court 1 yourself brings in a few more.
en.events.hc_trial_day.options.A: Go all out with flyers and a banner · −$150
en.events.hc_discover_kid.title: Mason has a natural swing
en.events.hc_discover_kid.body: The kid who sat on the court during Dale's lessons just hit three clean backhands in a row.
en.events.hc_discover_kid.options.B: Tell his parents he has talent
en.events.hc_pickleball_lease.title: The pickleball group wants a full-year lease
en.events.hc_pickleball_lease.body: They offer $800 up front to lock in Court 2 for the year. Your tennis members are not thrilled.
en.events.hc_pickleball_lease.options.C: Offer shared hours (go to Court 2; depends on reputation)
en.events.hc_pickleball_rant.title: The pickleball group is venting in the community chat
en.events.hc_pickleball_rant.body: "Hollow Creek doesn't want new people." The thread has forty replies.
en.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.A: Post a calm reply (depends on reputation)
en.events.hc_tug_of_war.title: The pickleball team challenges you to tug-of-war
en.events.hc_tug_of_war.body: Loser buys the lemonade. Tennis has never won one of these.
en.events.hc_clay_workday.title: Rescue the clay court?
en.events.hc_clay_workday.body: A tree is lying on the fence and the clay is more weed than court. Neighbors have offered to help.
en.events.hc_clay_workday.options.A: Run a community workday (go to the clay court)
en.events.hc_bubble_quote.title: The bubble company sent a quote
en.events.hc_bubble_quote.body: Re-inflating the dome costs $2,400. It would give you a court for rainy days.
en.events.hc_bubble_quote.options.B: Hold a fundraiser on the deck first
en.events.hc_developer_visit.title: A developer wants to buy the land
en.events.hc_developer_visit.body: $2.1 million for the whole site. Townhouses, he says. The board would take it.
en.events.hc_developer_return.title: The developer is back with a final offer
en.events.hc_developer_return.body: Same money, a firm deadline. This is the last time he asks.
en.events.hc_crow_ball.title: A crow just stole a ball from the basket
en.events.hc_crow_ball.body: It is sitting on the fence post, looking pleased with itself. The juniors are delighted.
en.events.hc_crow_ball.options.B: Put a lid on the basket · −$40
en.events.hc_rival_flyer.title: Pine Crown taped a recruiting flyer to our fence
en.events.hc_rival_flyer.body: "Real coaching. Real courts. 20% off your first month." Three parents have already taken a photo of it.
en.events.hc_rival_flyer.options.A: Swap it for our own flyer
en.events.hc_storm_leak.title: The clubhouse roof is leaking
en.events.hc_storm_leak.body: Rain is coming through over the trophy case. Members are moving chairs.
en.events.hc_community_match.title: Community match against Pine Crown
en.events.hc_community_match.body: Pine Crown is the club across the valley. Half the board will be watching.
en.events.hc_community_match.options.A: Field the strongest lineup with your coach
en.events.hc_board_vote.title: The board votes on selling the club
en.events.hc_board_vote.body: Quality, members, reputation and the Pine Crown match all count. Present your case on the deck.
en.events.hc_board_vote.options.A: Present in person on the deck
en.events.hc_board_vote.options.B: Let the numbers speak for themselves
en.events.hc_who_follows.title: Maple Ridge High wants you to run their program
en.events.hc_who_follows.body: You can bring one person with you.
en.log.started: You took over Hollow Creek Tennis Club.
en.ui.club.name: Hollow Creek TC

zh.activities.contractor.title: 外包施工队在红土场
zh.activities.fundraiser.title: 露台募捐晚会
zh.activities.tug_of_war.title: 和匹克球队拔河
zh.activities.match_strong.title: 社区对抗赛 vs 松冠俱乐部
zh.activities.match_juniors.title: 社区对抗赛 vs 松冠俱乐部（青少年上场）
zh.endings.saved_with_coach.title: Hollow Creek 保住了
zh.endings.saved_with_coach.body: 董事会投票保留俱乐部。枫岭高中发来聘书，你的教练跟你一起走。
zh.endings.saved_with_kid.title: Hollow Creek 保住了
zh.endings.saved_with_kid.body: 董事会投票保留俱乐部。枫岭高中请你去带网球队，Mason 也考进了枫岭。
zh.endings.saved_alone.title: Hollow Creek 保住了
zh.endings.saved_alone.body: 董事会投票保留俱乐部。你一个人去了枫岭高中。
zh.endings.club_sold.title: 俱乐部被卖了
zh.endings.club_sold.body: 董事会投票出售。停车场的出售牌没摘下来，Hollow Creek 月底关门。
zh.endings.sold_to_developer.title: 卖给了开发商
zh.endings.sold_to_developer.body: 你收了钱。到明年春天，这些球场会变成联排别墅。
zh.endings.bankrupt.title: 钱花光了
zh.endings.bankrupt.body: 俱乐部发不出工资，银行接管，本幕结束。
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.title: Dale 在青少年课上玩手机
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.body: Tyler 把球一个个打进围网，Mason 坐在场地上发呆。Dale 已经十分钟没抬头了。
zh.events.hc_dale_phone.options.A: 走到 1 号场，当面跟他说
zh.events.hc_parent_complaint.title: Carter 女士要找你谈课程的事
zh.events.hc_parent_complaint.body: “我儿子交的是课时费，不是托管费。”她就站在 1 号场门口。
zh.events.hc_parent_complaint.options.C: 站在教练一边 · 会员 −2，声望 −3
zh.events.hc_board_memo.title: 董事会要你处理 Dale
zh.events.hc_board_memo.body: 项目质量崩了，会员在流失。董事会要你今天就拿出办法。
zh.events.hc_board_memo.options.B: 在露台上私下谈，请他走人
zh.events.hc_dale_relapse.title: Dale 又在看手机了
zh.events.hc_dale_relapse.body: 再给一次机会只撑了一天。孩子们在拿球互相打。
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.title: 招一个新的主教练
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.body: 三个人回了招聘启事。你选的人，以后可能跟你去下一站。
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.options.A: Jess Park · 热血新人，每周 $250
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.options.B: Walt Hendricks · 疲惫的老手，每周 $420
zh.events.hc_hire_coach.options.C: Nadia Volkov · 前职业球员，每周 $900，签约费 $600
zh.events.hc_fix_court1.title: 1 号场快散架了
zh.events.hc_fix_court1.body: 裂缝里长了草，球网中间塌下去。本地的施工队这周能来补。
zh.events.hc_trial_day.title: 办一场免费试训日？
zh.events.hc_trial_day.body: 开放一下午，看看谁会来。你亲自到 1 号场，能多拉来几个人。
zh.events.hc_trial_day.options.A: 大张旗鼓，发传单挂横幅 · −$150
zh.events.hc_discover_kid.title: Mason 的挥拍是天生的
zh.events.hc_discover_kid.body: 在 Dale 课上坐在地上发呆的那个孩子，刚刚连着打了三个干净的反手。
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.title: 匹克球那帮人想签一整年的租约
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.body: 他们先付 $800，把 2 号场包一整年。网球会员不太高兴。
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.options.B: 把 2 号场收回来打网球
zh.events.hc_pickleball_lease.options.C: 提议分时段（走到 2 号场去谈，成败看声望）
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.title: 匹克球那帮人在社区群里吐槽你
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.body: “Hollow Creek 不欢迎新人。”帖子底下已经四十条回复。
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.A: 心平气和地回一帖（成败看声望）
zh.events.hc_pickleball_rant.options.B: 请他们来打一场友谊赛
zh.events.hc_tug_of_war.title: 匹克球队向你们发起拔河挑战
zh.events.hc_tug_of_war.body: 输的一方请喝柠檬水。网球这边从来没赢过。
zh.events.hc_tug_of_war.options.B: 你亲自上（走到 2 号场）
zh.events.hc_clay_workday.title: 把红土场救回来？
zh.events.hc_clay_workday.body: 一棵树倒在围网上，场地上草比土多。邻居们说可以来帮忙。
zh.events.hc_clay_workday.options.A: 发起社区劳动日（走到红土场）
zh.events.hc_bubble_quote.title: 气膜公司发来报价
zh.events.hc_bubble_quote.body: 重新充气要 $2,400。充起来以后，下雨天也有场地可用。
zh.events.hc_bubble_quote.options.B: 先在露台上办一场募捐晚会
zh.events.hc_developer_visit.title: 开发商想买下这块地
zh.events.hc_developer_visit.body: 整块地 210 万美元。他说要盖联排别墅。董事会会同意的。
zh.events.hc_developer_return.title: 开发商带着最后报价回来了
zh.events.hc_developer_return.body: 一样的价钱，有明确的期限。这是他最后一次开口。
zh.events.hc_crow_ball.title: 一只乌鸦从球筐里叼走了一个球
zh.events.hc_crow_ball.body: 它站在围网柱子上，一脸得意。孩子们乐坏了。
zh.events.hc_rival_flyer.title: Pine Crown 把招生传单贴到了我们的围网上
zh.events.hc_rival_flyer.body: 「真正的教练，真正的场地，首月八折。」已经有三位家长拍了照。
zh.events.hc_rival_flyer.options.B: 打电话去 Pine Crown 抗议
zh.events.hc_storm_leak.title: 会所屋顶漏雨
zh.events.hc_storm_leak.body: 雨水从奖杯柜上方漏下来，会员们在搬椅子。
zh.events.hc_storm_leak.options.C: 今天会所关门 · 会员 −1
zh.events.hc_community_match.title: 社区对抗赛 vs 松冠俱乐部
zh.events.hc_community_match.body: 松冠是山谷对面那家俱乐部。董事会一半的人会来看。
zh.events.hc_community_match.options.A: 派出最强阵容，教练带队
zh.events.hc_board_vote.title: 董事会就出售俱乐部投票
zh.events.hc_board_vote.body: 质量、会员、声望和对松冠的比赛结果都算数。到露台上去讲你的理由。
zh.events.hc_who_follows.title: 枫岭高中请你去带他们的网球队
zh.events.hc_who_follows.body: 你可以带一个人一起走。
zh.log.started: 你接手了 Hollow Creek 网球俱乐部。
zh.ui.club.name: 霍洛溪网球俱乐部
